0.0: Hey! You helped me the other day! You know, even after I showed my dad the items you got me, he still wouldn't let me travel... Hmph. He said he knew I didn't get them myself.
0.1: I gave up on that dream shortly afterwards. Ah well. Anyway, I want to ask you for another favor... Do you have time?
0.2: I have a new dream. Being a traveler would be too tough for a pretty girl like me, hehe, so my new life ambition is to become a great alchemist! Someday I will be a better alchemist than even Maria in #m102000000#! Better believe it!
0.3: Alchemy isn't nearly as dangerous as traveling the world, so my dad's not against it. Oh! Do you even know what alchemy is? I better explain...
0.4: Alchemists can manipulate all sorts of matter to create special items.
0.5: You can guess where this is going, right? Hehe, I need materials to practice on! Can you please gather some for me?

yes.0: Awesome! Let's see... I need #b1 #t2022000##k, #b30 Medicines with Weird Vibes#k, and #b20 #t4000041#s#k. If all goes well, I can make #t2000004#s!

no.0: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: Yippee! You got #b1 #t2022000##k, #b30 #t4000036##k, and #b20 #t4000041##k! Now, my turn. I just gotta mix these babies together and...
1.1: Voila! You know, this is my first time actually doing alchemy. Am I good or what? Here you go. Take it as a gift.

yes.0: Wow. I've got a talent for this. I made 10 #r#t2000004#s#k during my very first experiment. You did your part to help, of course! Thank you.

item.0: You haven't collected #b1 #t2022000##k, #b30 #t4000036##k, and #b20 #t4000041#s#k yet! I believe some vendors sell #t2022000#. You can get the other stuff from monsters.

QuestInfo.name: Jane's First Challenge
QuestInfo.0: You hear Jane's got herself a new life ambition...
QuestInfo.1: Last time, you got Jane some boar's teeth to convince her dad to let her travel. That didn't work. Now she has a new dream. She wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. Now, she needs materials... You can guess where this is going. She wants you to get her #b1 Pure Water, 30 Medicines with Weird Vibes, and 20 Malady's Experimental Frogs#k so she can make some Elixir.
QuestInfo.2: You got the materials Jane needed to make some elixir. If she fails...is the whole place going to blow up?
